quotes.text: Mercifully hast thou dealt with us, our Father ; for through all the scenes which thy people have been called to pass — all the perils, and watchings, and sufferings we have had to encounter, thine angels have watched over and protected us, and the gentle and refreshing influences of thy spirit have comforted us, and we have been spared as monuments of thy mercy.
